intro.h2: Every kitchen style under one roof
paragraphs: Modern Design Center handles kitchen remodeling Cherry Hill homeowners can plan from first sketch to final build. The company designs, remodels, renovates and builds kitchens and bathrooms, and it offers complete kitchen design using cabinets from top European and American manufacturers.

The point is choice without running around. Traditional, transitional and European designs are all available in one place, from sleek handleless high-gloss fronts to warmer wood looks. One past kitchen pairs white gloss cabinets with a bright red gloss island. The team also helps with bathroom vanities, wall panels and tile, and is happy to explain the basics, like how to tell ceramic from porcelain.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling Cherry Hill and bathroom services

items.name: Kitchen design and remodeling
items.blurb: Complete kitchen design and remodeling, from layout to installation. Choose European style handleless cabinets, American style cabinetry, or a transitional look in between. A past project pairs high-gloss white cabinets with a red gloss island and stainless appliances.

image.alt: Open kitchen with glossy white flat-panel cabinets, red gloss island, stainless wall ovens and side-by-side refrigerator

items.name: European style kitchens
items.blurb: Modern Design Center has featured European cabinet lines with textured and high-gloss fronts, including glass and aluminum doors offered in 11 colors. If you want a clean, contemporary kitchen, this is the place to see the options side by side.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling and vanities
items.blurb: Bathroom remodels with vanities in painted gray, navy and warm wood finishes, set against marble-look wall panels. Pick the vanity, top and wall finish together so the whole room is planned as one design rather than piece by piece.

image.alt: Bathroom vanities in gray, navy and wood beside marble-look wall panels and wood slat panels on wood-look flooring

items.name: Tile and wall finishes
items.blurb: Tile, marble-look panels and wood slat feature walls for kitchens and baths. Not sure what you are looking at? The team regularly answers questions like how to tell ceramic tile from porcelain, so you can choose with confidence.

items.name: Additions and alterations
items.blurb: Beyond kitchens and baths, Modern Design Center supports home improvement projects for new houses, additions and alterations. Call to talk through how a new kitchen or bathroom fits into a larger renovation or an addition you are planning.

about.text: Modern Design Center is a kitchen and bath company on Haddonfield Road in Cherry Hill Township, New Jersey. It designs, remodels, renovates and builds kitchens and bathrooms, and supports larger home improvement projects including new houses, additions and alterations. The focus is complete kitchen design using cabinets from top manufacturers, in both European and American styles. The team has worked with European lines known for textured, glass and aluminum fronts, and keeps traditional and transitional designs on offer for homeowners who want a classic look.

image.alt: Display of bathroom vanities, marble-look panels and wood slat walls

steps.title: Visit or call
steps.text: Call (856) 288-1300 or stop by 912 Haddonfield Rd during opening hours to talk about your kitchen or bathroom.

steps.title: Choose a style
steps.text: Compare traditional, transitional and European designs, door finishes and colors, and settle on the look you want.

steps.title: Design the layout
steps.text: The team plans the layout, cabinets, counters and finishes for your room and walks you through the design and price.

steps.title: Remodel and build
steps.text: Modern Design Center carries out the remodel, from removing the old room to installing the new cabinets and finishes.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: Walk the finished kitchen or bath with the team and check doors, drawers and finishes before the job is closed out.

service_area.text: Modern Design Center is located at 912 Haddonfield Rd, Unit B, in Cherry Hill Township, New Jersey. Cherry Hill is the town named on its Google profile and Facebook page. If you live in or near Cherry Hill and want to know whether your project is in range, call (856) 288-1300 or stop in during opening hours, which include Saturday and Sunday.

items.q: What kitchen styles do you offer?
items.a: Traditional, transitional and European designs, all in one place. The company offers complete kitchen design using cabinets from top manufacturers in both European and American styles, including high-gloss and textured European fronts and glass and aluminum doors in a range of colors.

Yes. Modern Design Center designs, remodels, renovates and builds both kitchens and bathrooms. Bathroom options include vanities in painted and wood finishes and wall finishes like marble-look panels and wood slats. Call to talk through the bathroom you have in mind.

items.q: Where are you and when are you open?
items.a: 912 Haddonfield Rd B, Cherry Hill Township, NJ 08002. Hours are Monday to Friday 10 AM to 5 PM, Saturday 10 AM to 3 PM and Sunday 11 AM to 4 PM. Call (856) 288-1300 before you visit if you want to set aside time with a designer.

items.q: How can I tell ceramic tile from porcelain?
items.a: Customers ask this a lot, and Modern Design Center shared a quick test on its Facebook page: pour just a little water on the tile and watch what happens. Ask the team to walk you through it on real samples when you choose tile for your new kitchen or bathroom.

items.q: Can you help with an addition or a bigger renovation?
items.a: Yes. Besides kitchens and bathrooms, the company supports home improvement projects for new houses, additions and alterations. Call (856) 288-1300 and describe the whole project, so the team can plan your new kitchen or bathroom as part of the larger job from the start.
